text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is upon us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is our chance to show the
spectators, the
younger students, and
my future rivals the beauty
of our dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I'm to realize my ideals, then this is
one race I
cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
choice_data_list: Relax your shoulders and give it your all out there.
Relax your shoulders when you run.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I'm an open book to you, aren't I?
You're
right, of course—I am getting a
little swept up in
the spirit of the race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But how else would you have me feel?
The crowd
expects the best from me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You aspire to the title of Derby Trainer,
don't
you? As surely every trainer must.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So if I simply race to realize my own
ambitions,
then yours will come about
naturally.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, you need do nothing more than sit
back
and watch. The stands are packed
with fans who
have come to watch
dreams take flight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let the Emperor give them one to cheer
for.
